note: Shop products. Owner edits this file, then rebuild (python3 shop_build.py && python3 build_site.py). Fields: id (lowercase letters, digits, hyphen; stored with each interest request, so never reuse an id for a different product), level (1-6), name, description, formats (soft = PDF download, physical = printed and posted in Singapore), status ('coming-soon' or 'available'), price_cents (optional; a whole number for all formats, or {"soft":..,"physical":..}). PRICES ARE ON HOLD (owner, 23 Oct 2026): the page shows a price ONLY when status is 'available' AND price_cents is set; leave price_cents out and keep every status 'coming-soon' until the owner decides. See docs/shop/README.md.
